description: This source file defines a factory class for creating EnforcerRetriever instances, which retrieve enforcers based on resource types (policy or access control list) using specified caches. It is part of the enforcement service of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PolicyOrAclEnforcerRetrieverFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing static methods to create EnforcerRetriever instances configured with caches for policies and ACLs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an EnforcerRetriever configured with specified caches for policy and ACL enforcers, mapped to resource types.
